DECLARE @SNOWNUMBER VARCHAR(1000)=@Extract_Name_Progress_IN
DECLARE @NAME VARCHAR(800)=@Extract_Name_IN
DECLARE @LEN1 INT= LEN(@SNOWNUMBER)
INSERT INTO  [dbo].[DX_CodeReview](SNOW_NUMBER,DATE_FOLDER_PLACED,NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW,NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE,GO_LIVE_DATE,FLAG,NAME)
SELECT CASE WHEN @LEN1<28 THEN @SNOWNUMBER ELSE LEFT(@SNOWNUMBER,10) end
,CASE WHEN @LEN1<28  THEN '' ELSE RIGHT(LEFT(@SNOWNUMBER,19),8) end
,CASE WHEN @LEN1<28  THEN '' ELSE DATEDIFF(DD,RIGHT(LEFT(@SNOWNUMBER,19),8),GETDATE()) end,
CASE WHEN @LEN1<28  THEN '' ELSE DATEDIFF(DD,GETDATE(),RIGHT(@SNOWNUMBER,8)) end,
CASE WHEN @LEN1<28 THEN 'INVALID FOLDER NAME' ELSE RIGHT(@SNOWNUMBER,8) end ,

'IN-PROGRESS',RIGHT(@NAME,CHARINDEX('\',REVERSE(@NAME))-1)

DECLARE @SNOWNUMBER VARCHAR(800)=@Extract_Name
DECLARE @LEN INT= LEN(@SNOWNUMBER)
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DX_CodeReview](SNOW_NUMBER,DATE_FOLDER_PLACED,NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW,NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE,GO_LIVE_DATE,FLAG)

SELECT CASE WHEN @LEN<28 THEN @SNOWNUMBER ELSE LEFT(@SNOWNUMBER,10) end
,CASE WHEN @LEN<28  THEN '' ELSE RIGHT(LEFT(@SNOWNUMBER,19),8) end
,CASE WHEN @LEN<28  THEN '' ELSE DATEDIFF(DD,RIGHT(LEFT(@SNOWNUMBER,19),8),GETDATE()) end,
CASE WHEN @LEN<28  THEN '' ELSE DATEDIFF(DD,GETDATE(),RIGHT(@SNOWNUMBER,8)) end,
CASE WHEN @LEN<28 THEN 'INVALID FOLDER NAME' ELSE RIGHT(@SNOWNUMBER,8) end ,'AWAITING'

DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX) ; DECLARE @tableHTML1 NVARCHAR(MAX) ; DECLARE @tableHTML2 NVARCHAR(MAX) ; DECLARE @Body NVARCHAR(MAX); IF EXISTS( SELECT [SNOW_NUMBER],[DATE_FOLDER_PLACED],[NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE],[NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW],[GO_LIVE_DATE],[FLAG],NAME FROM [dbo].[DX_CodeReview] WHERE FLAG='AWAITING' AND (([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2)<=2) AND GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME') BEGIN SET @tableHTML = N'

HIGH PRIORITY CODE REVIEW FOLDERS

' + N'' + N'' + CAST(( SELECT td = SNOW_NUMBER, '', td= DATE_FOLDER_PLACED, '', td= CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN ([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2) ELSE '' END, '', td = CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN [NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW] ELSE '' END, '', td = CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE] ELSE '' END, '', td = GO_LIVE_DATE,'', td= CASE WHEN([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2)<=2 AND GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME'THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END --td= CASE WHEN [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]<4 AND GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME'THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM [dbo].[DX_CodeReview] where FLAG='AWAITING' AND (([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2)<=2) AND GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' ORDER BY [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE] DESC FOR XML PATH('tr'), TYPE) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'
SNOWDate Folder Placed Days Left To Finish Code Review Number Of Days In Code ReviewNumber Of Days To Go-LiveGo-Live DateHigh Priority
' END ELSE BEGIN SET @tableHTML = N'' + N'
THERE ARE NO HIGH PRIORITY CODE REVIEW FOLDERS.
' + '' END IF EXISTS( SELECT [SNOW_NUMBER],[DATE_FOLDER_PLACED],[NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE],[NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW],[GO_LIVE_DATE],[FLAG],NAME FROM [dbo].[DX_CodeReview] WHERE FLAG='AWAITING' AND (([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2)>2)) BEGIN SET @tableHTML1 = N'

Code Review Pending

' + N'' + N'' + CAST(( SELECT td = SNOW_NUMBER, '', td= DATE_FOLDER_PLACED, '', td= CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN ([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2) ELSE '' END, '', td = CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN [NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW] ELSE '' END, '', td = CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE] ELSE '' END, '', td = GO_LIVE_DATE --td= CASE WHEN([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2)<=2 AND GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME'THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END --td= CASE WHEN [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]<4 AND GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME'THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM [dbo].[DX_CodeReview] where FLAG='AWAITING' AND (([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2)>2) ORDER BY [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE] DESC FOR XML PATH('tr'), TYPE) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'
SNOWDate Folder Placed Days Left To Finish Code Review Number Of Days In Code ReviewNumber Of Days To Go-LiveGo-Live Date
' END ELSE BEGIN SET @tableHTML1 = N'' + N'
THERE ARE NO FOLDERS FOR CODE REVIEW.
' + '' END IF EXISTS( SELECT [SNOW_NUMBER],[DATE_FOLDER_PLACED],[NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE],[GO_LIVE_DATE],[FLAG],NAME FROM [dbo].[DX_CodeReview] WHERE FLAG='IN-PROGRESS') BEGIN SET @tableHTML2 = N'

Code Review In-Progress

' + N'' + N'' + CAST(( SELECT td = NAME, '', td = SNOW_NUMBER, '', td= DATE_FOLDER_PLACED, '', td= CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN ([NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE]-2) ELSE '' END, '', td = CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN [NO_OF_DAYS_CODEREVIEW] ELSE '' END, '', td = CASE WHEN GO_LIVE_DATE <>'INVALID FOLDER NAME' THEN [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE] ELSE '' END, '', td = GO_LIVE_DATE FROM [dbo].[DX_CodeReview] where FLAG='IN-PROGRESS' ORDER BY [NO_OF_DAYS_GOLIVE] DESC FOR XML PATH('tr'), TYPE) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'
Code Reviewer NameSNOWDate Folder Placed Days Left To Finish Code Review Number Of Days In Code ReviewNumber Of Days To Go-LiveGo-Live Date
' END ELSE BEGIN SET @tableHTML2 = N'' + N'
THERE ARE NO CODE REVIEW FOLDERS WHICH ARE IN-PROGRESS.
' + '' END SET @Body = @tableHTML+ @tableHTML1 + @tableHTML2 EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients=@EmailList , @subject = 'CODE REVIEW' , @body = @Body , @body_format = 'HTML'
